_doc: Baseline questionnaire item bank. Add items for other grades by adding entries with that grade (prenursery | nursery | lkg | ukg) — no code changes. Media paths are PLACEHOLDERS relative to the CDN (EXPO_PUBLIC_CDN_BASE_URL); replace them with real files. Per item: difficulty 1-3; type tap_choice | count_tap | match | parent_observed. count_tap shows `images` (one picture per object to count). match shows `images` as the target to match. Options: {id, image?, label}; `label` is shown to parents only (child items show pictures). parent_observed items with an empty `options` use common.parent_options (Yes / Sometimes / Not yet), whose `credit` (1 / 0.5 / 0) scores the answer; prompt_audio may be null for them since a parent reads them.

common.encouragement_text: Thank you! Let's look at the next one.
